g.text: Source analysis status: complete_preflight; complete = True
Filled/open: repetition 1/2. Small/large optimized markers: B32/B64. ×: ineligible or eligibility unavailable. ▽: floor.
Optimized x includes the measured common parent prefix plus continuation. Parent and cheap controls use complete own costs.
Shared parent spending is counted once in study totals. Exact raw coordinates are retained; missing values have no invented location. No confidence bands.
